title: Don't be passionate
coreMove: Separate durable commitment from the dramatic feeling of being all-in.
sourcePressure: Aspire section: discipline over ego-heavy intensity. Supported by frozen source sidecar.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reading the warning as anti-care, when the target is performative heat that cannot survive repetition.
